cover-1.alt: A collage: Cam Anh in a blue shirt stands between red temple pillars with gold tops, in front of a wall of thick vertical stripes of colourful paint, on a green woven mat, against a red-to-green gradient.

know-1.alt: Cam Anh in profile, hair in a clip, looking closely at a mirror-polished silver sculpture in a pale gallery.

know-4.alt: A hand opening gold foil to reveal a dark chocolate bar stamped with an M, on a wooden table.
